title: Metabolomics Analysis of Third Instar Wandering Larvae
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rtad6ie

steps.title: Prepare Larvae Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh female third instar wandering larvae and add methanol to achieve a final concentration of 20 mg/ml for each sample.

steps.title: Extract Metabolites
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites from the prepared samples using an ultrasonic probe and incubation.

substeps.instruction: Process with an ultrasonic probe for 30 s
Incubate for 1 h at 4° C
Centrifuge to remove particulates

steps.title: Derivatize Supernatant
steps.instruction: Take 100 µl aliquots of the supernatant and derivatize them prior to mass spectrometric interrogation.

steps.title: Configure GC/MSD System
steps.instruction: Set up the Agilent GC/MSD system (controlled by Chemstation software) with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Set GC inlet temperature to 230° C
Use a 30 m SH-RXi-5Sil MS column (Shimadzu) with 0.25 mm internal diameter and 0.25 µm film thickness
Set helium carrier gas to a constant flow of 1.0 ml/min
Set MSD auxiliary temperature to 280° C
Set source temperature to 230° C
Set quadrupole temperature to 150° C

steps.title: Inject Sample and Run GC
steps.instruction: Inject the derivatized sample and perform chromatographic separation using a programmed oven temperature.

substeps.instruction: Inject 1.0 µl of derivatised sample in splitless mode
Set oven temperature to 70° C for 2 min
Ramp oven temperature at 15° C/min to 320° C
Hold at 320° C for 8 min

steps.title: Record Mass Spectra
steps.instruction: Record electron ionisation mass spectra using the following settings:

substeps.instruction: Set scan rate to 1.4 scans/s
Set mass range m/z 50–700

steps.title: Identify Analytes
steps.instruction: Identify analytes using the NIST 2011-Wiley Mass Spectra Library.

substeps.instruction: Consider peaks with a match quality (spectral purity) of more than 70% as tentatively identified

steps.title: Perform Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Process the resulting data for statistical analysis.

substeps.instruction: Normalize by maintaining a constant sample mass per volume (no internal standard used)
Log-transform peak areas
Perform statistical analysis using the limma package
Apply Benjamini-Hochberg’s correction to control the FDR
